primary_contrast: O-RC minus O-R; both retain nominal progression; only correction-score term removed
historical_terminology_correction: The old evaluation policy says progression-aware/omitted. Later observer/scope decisions replaced that with same-state residual versus residual-plus-correction. No claim of removing progression from O-R.
implementation_designation: Independent deterministic controls and empirical observer, not faithful reproductions of CASPER/TWINE/CatBoost, and not validated physical twin

normal_selection.candidate_grid: velocity singleton; template bins 32/64; AR orders 1/4 x ridge .001/.1; seven deterministic candidates
normal_selection.objective: template and AR separately minimize normal-development mean standardized prediction MSE; stable declared candidate order breaks exact ties
normal_selection.checkpoints: Closed-form/train-only references; no epoch checkpoints, no train+development refit
normal_selection.observer: Reuse selected 32-bin training template, period 38 s. Mixing .02 fixed. tau=max(train mean nearest-template distance,1e-8). a and b from train-only mean residual and JS. No tau/mixing/score-weight search.
normal_selection.extension: Four explanatory scores prescribed by prior-art review before calibration, no new fitting/selection
normal_selection.failure_policy: Every original candidate, success/failure, and selected artifact remains in source study records

preprocessing: Training-only Welford population moments; q then qdot; no clipping, imputation, resampling or lookahead. Constant/nonfinite channels fail. Frozen scaler shared by template/AR/observer; V-Z uses velocity moments.
initialization: Each partition starts fresh. Common 1528 preceding observations; resets only dt<=0 or >.075s. Observer uniform prior at start/break. Template minimizes cumulative warmup phase-offset loss then fixes offset. AR warmup fills four past samples. No reset at final report or event boundaries.
adaptation: State correction only; no fitted parameter, residual-normalizer or threshold updates
reporting: All eleven deterministic methods, complete masks, unadjusted mixed confusion/P/R/F1/AP, held-out-normal point and episode burden/exposure, all eight event outcomes with misses and censored delays, every zero recovery interval, coverage and actual compute; no posthoc composite winner, confidence interval or significance claim
delayed_join: Final feature scoring never interprets labels. All eleven streams and coordinates must seal, supervisor succeed, manifests/hashes validate, then separate evaluate-final may open labels.
protection: Procedural interfaces and logical append-only access/attempt records; no OS blinding or independent custodian
